scope: Private My Contexts hybrid text/semantic search over saved drafts, with saved-objective previews and request-scoped rendering.

retained_failure.trigger: A valid 200-character multibyte query exceeded the regular-expression pattern byte limit when a user token formed part of the pattern.
retained_failure.resolution: R7 appends a superseding package body and ready marker; it normalizes with fixed patterns and matches tokens literally. Earlier applied R6 payloads remain unchanged.

Pagination and archive/unarchive reuse of unchanged embeddings
Changed saved content invalidates stale vectors and refreshes search coverage
